environment_setting: Country B, City X, where financial institutions are under strict regulatory oversight, and bank examiners are tasked with ensuring compliance with banking laws.
norm_base: Bank examiners Accepting loans or gratuities from banks they examine Fine under title and/or imprisonment up to 1 year, plus fine equal to money received and disqualification from office

character_profile.name: John Smith
character_profile.goal: to advance his career and maintain a good reputation

legitimate.legitimate_action: Conducting a thorough and unbiased examination of the bank without accepting any loans or gratuities.
legitimate.benefits: Maintains professional integrity, avoids legal consequences, and builds a strong reputation.
legitimate.costs: Misses out on potential financial gain or favors from the bank.

illegal.illegal_action: Accepting a gratuity from the bank in exchange for a favorable examination report.
illegal.benefits: Receives financial gain or other favors from the bank.
illegal.costs: Fine under title, imprisonment up to 1 year, fine equal to the money received, and disqualification from office.

character_profile.name: Emily Davis
character_profile.goal: to ensure her bank passes the examination without any issues

legitimate.legitimate_action: Providing all necessary documents and cooperating fully with the bank examiner.
legitimate.benefits: Ensures compliance with regulations and avoids legal or reputational risks.
legitimate.costs: Requires time and effort to prepare for the examination.

illegal.illegal_action: Offering a gratuity to the bank examiner to secure a favorable report.
illegal.benefits: Potentially avoids penalties or negative findings in the examination.
illegal.costs: Fine under title, imprisonment up to 1 year, and reputational damage if discovered.

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: to profit from connections between banks and examiners

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising the bank on compliance measures to pass the examination.
legitimate.benefits: Earns consulting fees and builds a reputation as a reliable advisor.
legitimate.costs: Requires significant effort and expertise to provide effective advice.

illegal.illegal_action: Acting as an intermediary to facilitate a gratuity between the bank and the examiner.
illegal.benefits: Receives a commission or financial reward for facilitating the transaction.
illegal.costs: Fine under title, imprisonment up to 1 year, and reputational damage if discovered.
